items.toString:
{panel:bgColor=#deebff}
h2. Add PCP graphs to job results under Spyglass

This task aims to add PCP graphs to job results under Spyglass to support troubleshooting efforts.

h3. Goal

Make Performance Co-Pilot (PCP) graphs available from job results in Spyglass so users can quickly investigate performance-related issues without leaving the troubleshooting workflow.

h3. Scope

* Add PCP graph visibility or access points to relevant Spyglass job result pages.
* Ensure graphs are associated with the correct job result and time window.
* Support troubleshooting by making key performance signals easy to find and review.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* PCP graphs are displayed or linked from Spyglass job results.
* Behavior is documented or discoverable for users reviewing job results.
{panel}

items.toString: This work item links to "openshift-eng/edge-tooling#210: USHIFT-7312: Add interactive per-VM PCP performance dashboard skill (Web Link)"

items.fromString:
Create a CI Doctor skill that generates a per-VM PCP performance dashboard for a given job run or collected PCP archive. The skill should discover the VMs involved in the run, extract the relevant PCP metrics for each VM, and produce an easy-to-use dashboard that helps engineers compare VM-level resource usage and identify performance bottlenecks while debugging failures or regressions.

The generated dashboard should make it straightforward to investigate problems further by showing key CPU, memory, disk, network, and load metrics per VM over time. It should include clear labels for each VM, preserve links or references back to the source job/artifacts, and provide enough context for a user to correlate spikes or saturation with test events.

Acceptance criteria:

* A user can invoke the skill with a CI job/run identifier or PCP artifact location.
* The skill locates and processes PCP data for each VM associated with the run.
* A per-VM dashboard is generated with core performance metrics such as CPU, memory, disk I/O, network I/O, and load.
* The output is ready for another engineer to open and use as a starting point for deeper debugging.
* The skill reports clear errors when PCP data is missing, incomplete, or cannot be parsed.
